method.option_strategy: 10 short SPY options and 1 long SPXW option, multiplier 100
method.primary_rule: Expiry morning SPY open selects quantity at frozen selected strike + $0.01, tolerance 1e-10; modeled SPY stock purchase occurs at expiry close; residual closes next session open. Options use one-calendar-day DTE from entry close to expiry close; stock holding can span weekends.
